Rocha is a highly skilled Physician Assistant with over 14 years of experience in integrative, functional, and internal medicine. Certified as a Functional Medicine Practitioner by the Institute of Functional Medicine (IFMCP), Gabriel holds a Master of Medical Science from Yale University and has expertise in advanced diagnostics, bioidentical hormone replacement therapy, chronic disease management, and cutting-edge regenerative treatments. A former U.S. Navy officer specializing in sports medicine, he is fluent in Spanish and dedicated to personalized, root-cause care. Services by Gabriel Rocha Hormone Balance & HRT Fatigue, weight gain, brain fog, mood swings, low libido. These aren't just 'part of getting older.' They're signs your hormones are off. We test the full panel, find the imbalance, and build a protocol that brings you back to baseline. Learn more → Peptide Therapy Med Matrix in South Portland, Maine offers peptide therapy including BPC-157, sermorelin, CJC-1295/Ipamorelin, Thymosin Alpha-1, and AOD-9604. All peptides are sourced from licensed 503A/503B compounding pharmacies and prescribed after 80+ biomarker lab testing. Every protocol includes follow-up monitoring. Learn more → Longevity & Anti-Aging Aging is inevitable. Declining is not. We use advanced testing, hormone optimization, peptide therapy, and metabolic protocols to help you maintain energy, strength, cognitive function, and quality of life as you age.
